feat: resolve JSON Pointers (RFC 6901)

Add resolvePointer(document, pointer), exported from src/index.ts. It returns the
value a JSON Pointer refers to and throws for an invalid pointer or one that does
not resolve. Tests cover the RFC 6901 examples and the edge and error paths, and
run through the npm test script.
